device.description: 10-bit single-channel serial-output ADC (3-wire CS, I/O CLOCK, DATA OUT)
device.note: tlc1549.pdf (SLAS059C) p.1 pinout (D/JG/P), p.3 terminal functions and serial modes, p.4 Table 1, p.7 recommended operating conditions, p.9 operating characteristics (tconv, timing)

pages: p.1 (pinout), p.3 (terminal functions, detailed description), p.4-5 (Table 1, modes), p.6 (CS starts all modes), p.7 (ROC), p.9 (tconv 21 us, td(I/O-DATA) 240 ns, tPZH 1.3 us, tPHZ 180 ns), p.10-13 (timing figures)
notModeled: analog input and references: every conversion returns the 0 V code

conversion start: the datasheet starts it on the 10th I/O CLOCK falling edge; modeled at CS rise (the part has no EOC pin, so only the order matters); the previous result is shifted out (constant code)
modes 2, 4 and 6 (CS held low continuously; MSB within 21 us of the 10th clock or after the 16th clock): only CS-framed transfers are modeled
CS setup/debounce (two internal clock edges), CS abort, slow-mode timing (11th clock within 21 us)
tValid = tPZH 1.3 us; tOut = td(I/O-DATA) 240 ns; tFloat = tPHZ 180 ns
variants: FK (LCCC-20) package (M grade) has a different numbering; not in the parts list.
